verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says you can download vue(.min).js and be ready to go with no package manager or bundler [vue-comm-6]. Another user notes Vue can be dropped selectively into existing templates [vue-comm-4], and the docs describe Vue as incrementally adoptable [vue-docs-2]. One complaint about build-tool dependency [vue-comm-16] concerns full app builds rather than script-tag use, so it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on the CDN/script-tag install path (the Quick Start entry [vue-docs-10] is only a title), and recent corroboration covering current Vue versions.
